clips.title: The story
paras: Mo'grosh Crystals are rare mineral formations mined and hoarded by the Mo'grosh ogres in northeastern Loch Modan. Prized for their unusual alchemical properties, they serve as a vital component in neutralizing Dark Iron demolition materials.

Tucked away in the crags of northeastern Loch Modan, the Mo'grosh ogres excavate these distinctive crystals from their stronghold. Though the brute-strength ogres rarely specialize in delicate metallurgy, Mo'grosh Crystals are prized treasures among their clan, carried by common enforcers, mystic shamans, and their towering leaders alike. The crystals are relatively uncommon, making them a heavily guarded possession within the Mo'grosh Stronghold.
